migration.title: Migration to Open Source GIS
migration.description: I manage every stage of your migration to open source GIS, from planning to ongoing support. My process includes:
items: Assessment — Evaluation of your current GIS system and collection of real use needs from the team and stakeholders.
Migration Plan — Based on the assessment, I define a plan that minimizes disruptions while respecting time and budget constraints.
Implementation — I work side-by-side with your team to execute the migration plan.
Training and Documentation — I train the team to use the new open source GIS and deliver documentation of the main workflows.
Ongoing Support — No migration ends at go-live. I offer continuous support to ensure long-term success.

database.title: Spatial Database Design

qgis.title: QGIS Development
qgis.description: I create custom QGIS applications and plugins that accelerate workflows and automate repetitive tasks. Solutions can include custom data entry forms, deep integration with PostGIS databases, actions to open local or linked files, and enterprise features like role-based access control, row and column-level security, and tailored validation rules for your organization.
